## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The pull-request description should include the required testing section so reviewers can assess how the change was verified.

## Changes
The pull request adds a helper that lowercases titles, replaces runs outside ASCII letters and digits with hyphens, and trims surrounding hyphens. This review read the added tests and existing coverage without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- PR body — correctness — Add the required testing section — This pull-request description omits the verification section required by `AGENTS.md:4`: “Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified.” — Reviewers cannot determine from the description whether the added tests were run or verification was limited to inspection.

## Suggestions
- app/slug.py:7 — tests — Add coverage for digits in titles — For a title such as `"Release 2"`, digit preservation is untested; none of the existing or added test inputs contains digits. — Removing `0-9` from the pattern would corrupt numbered page slugs while every current test still passes. — Fix: Extend `test_slugify` with a numbered title.
